title: 更新公告
content_zh:
昨天出了点小问题，所以鸽了一天，但也算不上鸽吧，怕大家着急看作品所以我就把第九章上半段先发出来了695字，实在抱歉。

    于是今天我就把第九章更完了一千六百多字，怕大家不知道我在第九章更了，所以特此通知一下各位，实在是不好意思。

    如果看完昨天第九章作品的小伙伴看到此通知就回第九章把第九章看完吧，谢谢了。

    非常感谢各位球球粉的支持与鼓励，希望大家能多多收藏，礼物推荐票多多支持，我废个球在此谢谢大家了！

    《逆仙成魔传》更新公告 正在手打中，请稍等片刻，

    内容更新后，请重新刷新页面，即可获取最新更新！
content_en:
There was a small problem yesterday, so I was slow down for a day, but I can’t really say I was slow down. I was afraid that people would be anxious to read the work, so I published the first half of Chapter 9 with 695 words. I’m really sorry.

    So today I have updated more than 1,600 words in Chapter 9. I am afraid that everyone will not know that I have updated Chapter 9, so I would like to inform you all. I am really sorry.

    If you guys who finished reading yesterday's Chapter 9 work see this notice, please go back to Chapter 9 and finish Chapter 9. Thank you.

    Thank you very much for your support and encouragement from all the fans of the game. I hope you can collect more and support the gift recommendation tickets. I would like to thank you all!

    The update announcement of "The Legend of the Immortal and the Demon" is being downloaded, please wait for a moment.

    After the content is updated, please refresh the page to get the latest updates!
